name: ACE-Step
tagline: Fast open-source music foundation model generating full multi-minute songs with vocals and lyrics locally.
real_test_summary: Tested generating full 3-minute songs with custom lyrics and style tags locally on a 6GB VRAM GPU. Renders tracks in under 20 seconds offline with clean vocal clarity.
pros: Generates multi-minute songs with vocals in seconds on 4GB-8GB VRAM
Apache-2.0 license allows unrestricted commercial music and video soundtracks
Supports lyric editing, style remixing, and Gradio web UI
cons: Vocal pronunciation can blur on rapid tongue-twister lyrics
Requires downloading multi-gigabyte diffusion checkpoints on first run
